cards.title: The cutout dock
cards.does: A person's cutout (a head, a bust) stands on the stage with no card, no paper, no border and no badge rail - a figure, not a document.
cards.when: a figure in our own argument may stand as a cutout on our stage over our crawl

lives.note: dockIsCutout (engine) + the template's `.dock.cutout` CSS; compiler DOCK_KIND_CUTOUT from the dock option `cutout`

cards.title: The image dock
cards.does: A still (a stamped document, a chart PNG, a screenshot) lands as a card over the world with its badge rail, reads, then parks or exits - the default dock kind, never written onto the entry.
cards.when: anything READ: their document, their chart, a citation, a stamped slide, a record, an instrument

author.key: dock tuple (asset_id, slot, enter, exit[, opts]) naming an asset that is not .mp4/.webm and carries no press/cutout

callable.why: the default kind; compiles on any row

cards.title: The press card dock
cards.does: A headline cropped from its screenshot lands in the stage's centre box with its masthead source line and the quoted phrase, underlined as it is said; alone it lands, holds and retracts.
cards.when: the sentence QUOTES a headline or a claim with a masthead (row 1) - THEIR claim never pages (B1); one card for one claim, the stack when three claims land in a row

author.key: dock option {'press': <press_card.py meta dict or its JSON path>}
author.example: {"press": {"kind": "press", "source": "The Herald, 4 Mar 2026", "phrase": {"x0": 0.12, "y0": 0.2, "x1": 0.66, "y1": 0.44}, "phrase_text": "the historic normal was never normal", "card": [1056, 313]}}

phases.name: land
phases.does: the card springs down into its box and fades up

phases.name: underline
phases.does: a callout species with the `underline` form draws under the quoted phrase, decelerating into its end
phases.trigger: the callout's own `at` on a `phrase` target

phases.name: retract
phases.does: past its exit the card holds the pose it left in and retracts on the dock's spring - never a dissolve

blends.source: Bravos shots 5-10 (their claims as cards on the plate)

options.means: press (the press-card meta): Marks the dock as a press card and carries press_card.py's meta (source, phrase box, phrase words).

lives.note: PRESS / pressStack / underlineFrac (the law, inlined by sync_kinetics) + engine paintPressCard / pressPose / pressMount (the DOM painter, inline); a real row passes the meta JSON path

callable.why: probe: dock_opts({'press': {...}}) compiles; press_plate_error refuses it on a ledger page

cards.title: The video dock
cards.does: A silent generated clip plays inside the card's frame over the standing page, seeked to the scene clock, instead of a still.
cards.when: a generated clip depicts or proves the sentence over a standing page - it lands as a card, never as the world

author.key: a dock asset whose file ends .mp4/.webm (VIDEO_SUFFIXES); the kind is the asset's, not a row key

first_use.build: build-short.v2 (render approved by the operator 2026-09-06, render/APPROVALS.json; 4 video docks)
